source_notes: Team user story: a user can edit and delete only their own posts.
Pre-existing posts API integration tests cover owner deletion, forbidden deletion by another user, and deletion of missing posts.
requirements: The author of an existing post can delete that post.
A user who does not own an existing post cannot delete that post.
Attempting to delete a post that does not exist produces a not-found error.
notes: Draft for independent requirement review before paid testing. Do not derive additional requirements from the implementation.
